verification_log.method: Majority scholarly identification Babylon–Media–Persia–Seleucid/Ptolemaic; iron-and-clay as Seleucid–Ptolemaic marriages (c. 250 or 193 BC); chapter in present form no earlier than early Seleucid period; Aramaic 2:4b–7:28 unexplained; royal dreams as portents; a Nabonidus inscription records a dream of Nebuchadnezzar; giant-figure parallels (Hesiod, Ovid, Bahman Yasht)
